body: Create a concept-design board for an original {{product}}. Arrange a large perspective sketch, front and side elevations, and two material-detail studies on white paper. Use controlled graphite lines, restrained marker shading and a few {{color}} accents. Keep geometry consistent between views and annotate only these design features: {{features}}. Present it like an early professional design proposal.

instructions.en: Supply product concept, accent color and design features; an exterior reference is optional.

en.title: Industrial concept sketch board
en.description: Perspective, elevations and detail studies describe one coherent product concept.
en.body:
## How to use

Supply product concept, accent color and design features; an exterior reference is optional.

Compare geometry between views; treat the result as an early visual proposal.

## Recorded result

The example was generated with the built-in image tool. Its exact model ID was not returned. The recorded run contains the submitted prompt and ordered inputs.
